report.summary: Chunk 1 of 2 of daedalus/eval/tasks.py: defines task shape, correctness task format, helper functions (resolve_task_repo, is_correctness_task, task_project_label), and begins the TASKS list with 12 tasks.
risks: resolve_task_repo | medium | Fallback to resolve_repo_root(None, repo) passes None as first arg; resolve_repo_root may not handle None. | Check resolve_repo_root signature and behavior with None.
task_project_label | low | Returns '<unknown>' for missing 'repo' key; but if 'repo' is present but None, returns '<unknown>' as well. | Confirm that None repo is intended to be treated as missing.
TASKS list | low | Task 'ikarus_distill' references 'daedalus/ikarus_os.py' but file may be named 'ikarus_os.py' or 'ikarus.py'? | Verify actual filename in agent_env repo.
TASKS list | low | Task 'projects_resolve_repo_root' references 'daedalus/projects.py' but path might be 'daedalus/projects.py'? | Verify actual path.

claims.text: Each task targets a real symbol/file in a small repo and records the symbols a *sufficient* distilled slice MUST carry to reason about that target.
claims.why: The claim about 'sufficient' symbols and 'real' targets cannot be verified from this chunk alone; must check against actual repos and slice behavior.

claims.text: The labels below were picked by reading the code and VERIFIED reachable by running ``semantic_slice`` (see ``daedalus.eval.harness``); a label is only listed if a competent answer about the target genuinely needs it AND it is a real dependency or caller in the neighborhood.
claims.why: Verification of reachability and necessity requires access to semantic_slice output and harness code; not present in this chunk.

claims.text: ``must_include`` items are matched as substrings against the slice text.
claims.why: The matching mechanism is described but not implemented in this chunk; must check harness._recall.

claims.text: For a symbol target the slice is 1-hop (the focus symbol's direct callees/callers), so we only label symbols reachable within that hop -- we do NOT claim transitive callees-of-callees are present when they are not.
claims.why: This describes slice behavior; not verifiable from this chunk.

claims.text: ``hand_reachable`` -- a human picked the label AND verified it reachable by running ``semantic_slice`` (see ``daedalus.eval.harness``). This is CIRCULAR: the slicer chose what it is graded on.
claims.why: Verification requires harness code; not present in this chunk.

claims.text: Every task below is this provenance today.
claims.why: All 12 tasks defined in this chunk have 'label_provenance': 'hand_reachable'.

claims.text: ``harness.run_tier1`` never blends it with the other provenances into one number.
claims.why: Behavior of harness.run_tier1 is not in this chunk.

claims.text: ``tier``: "primary" tasks count toward any go/no-go recall number. "quarantine" tasks are minted but not yet confirmed -- ``harness.run_tier1`` excludes them from every headline/aggregate and reports them separately
claims.why: Behavior of harness.run_tier1 is not in this chunk; all tasks here are 'primary'.

claims.text: a correctness task carries no ``must_include``, so scoring one with ``harness._recall`` would return the vacuous 1.0
claims.why: Harness._recall behavior not in this chunk; but is_correctness_task checks for correctness keys, not absence of must_include.

claims.text: ``is_correctness_task`` below is the single predicate that decides
claims.why: is_correctness_task is defined in this chunk and checks for correctness keys.

claims.text: ``harness.eval_task_tier1``/``eval_task_arms`` refuse such a task loudly (an ERRORED row, which ``run_gate`` reports and fails on for a primary tier) instead of grading it.
claims.why: Harness functions not in this chunk.

claims.text: Correctness tasks live in their own store (``correctness.DEFAULT_CORPUS_PATH``) and never enter ``harness.all_tasks()``.
claims.why: Store location and harness.all_tasks() not in this chunk.

claims.text: "agent_env"        -> this harness repo (dogfood target)
claims.why: resolve_task_repo returns AGENT_ENV_ROOT when repo == 'agent_env'.

claims.text: a registered name  -> daedalus.projects.resolve_repo_root (e.g. sunny_garden)
claims.why: resolve_task_repo calls resolve_repo_root(None, repo) if repo is in list_projects().

claims.text: an absolute path   -> used as-is (temp fixtures in tests)
claims.why: resolve_task_repo returns repo if os.path.isabs(repo) and Path(repo).exists().

claims.text: Deliberately keyed on the PRESENCE of the field, not on its truthiness: a task with ``"fail_to_pass": []`` is a correctness task with an empty (and therefore invalid, see ``correctness.validate_task``) test list, NOT a slice-recall task
claims.why: is_correctness_task uses 'any(k in task for k in CORRECTNESS_KEYS)', which checks presence, not truthiness.

claims.text: A task with NO ``repo`` key labels as ``"<unknown>"`` rather than raising ``KeyError``.
claims.why: task_project_label uses task.get('repo'), which returns None if key missing, then returns '<unknown>'.

claims.text: This function is called from ``harness._task_error_row``, i.e. on the REPORTING path for a task that is already known to be malformed, so a raise here turned "one bad task is reported as a degraded row" into "the whole eval run dies on it" -- the exact failure ``_task_error_row`` exists to prevent. Found by a test, not by reading.
claims.why: Call site in harness._task_error_row not in this chunk.

claims.text: All Tier-1 labels verified reachable against the current slices -- which is exactly the circularity documented above.
claims.why: Verification not present in this chunk.

claims.text: Every task is "hand_reachable" / "primary" until an "independent_diff" or "temporal_churn" minter (see daedalus.eval.mint, a separate track) adds tasks with independent labels.
claims.why: All 12 tasks in this chunk have 'label_provenance': 'hand_reachable' and 'tier': 'primary'.

claims.text: Updated when neighborhood expansion moved off the python-only dotted module map onto idx["import_edges"] (S2): ``_py_maps`` no longer exists, and its role -- supplying the lookup semantic_slice expands through -- is now ``_reverse_edges``. Ground truth follows the code; the symbol is still a real callee, verified against the call graph.
claims.why: Verification of call graph and existence of _reverse_edges not in this chunk; must_include includes '_reverse_edges'.

claims.text: Updated by the HONEST DENOMINATOR change (slice.py::_whole_repo_tokens): the primary path is now idx["total_tokens"] (tokenizer-measured, carried through by build_index); total_chars // 4 survives only as the fallback for an index dict that predates the field. The label tested total_chars unconditionally and was never updated when the code it grades moved off that formula -- ground truth follows the code (see the comment above this task).
claims.why: Verification of slice.py behavior not in this chunk; answer_contains includes 'total_tokens'.

claims.text: Updated when the per-file pass was extracted into perfile.py and parallelized: build_index no longer calls extract_units/file_metrics/python_imports directly -- they moved behind _per_file_pass. These are its real current dependencies, verified against the call graph. The slicer was NOT the thing that changed; the labels were stale.
claims.why: Verification of call graph not in this chunk; must_include includes '_per_file_pass'.
